thread:
maria-sales: Hey team — Kepler Tech POC stuck. We tried to provision a Dedicated GPU pool in asia-southeast1 but the reservation shows 'pending' and API returns 403 quota_error. Customer is on a tight timeline, can we triage? :eyes:

devon-ps: sharing the pool request id: pool_req_9f2b. Error from our deployer: 
```
HTTP 403 Forbidden
{"error":"quota_exceeded","details":"GPU quota for asia-southeast1 exhausted for project kepler-prod"}
```

sara-eng: Oof. That looks like regional GPU quota. Was this a single-AZ request with GPU type a100-80gb? Those are pretty constrained in that region.

ranjit-ml: Confirming — Kepler asked specifically for a100-80gb with AZ affinity (they want consistent latency). If that exact SKU/affinity combo is unavailable, the orchestrator will keep it pending instead of auto-fallback.

maria-sales: They insisted on the A100 due to perf checks. Is there an auto-fallback we can offer (different GPU or multi-AZ) without violating their security questionnaire? They asked for single-AZ for data residency reasons.

sara-eng: Two angles: 1) If we relax AZ affinity we can place across AZs in the same region which may satisfy residency but not single-AZ if they explicitly require it. 2) Use a compatible instance type (a40/q8) — we'd need signoff from Kepler on perf tradeoffs.

devon-ps: For immediate POC unblock we can: 1) short-term reserve a smaller pool (1x a100) in us-west2 and route requests there (needs approval), or 2) switch to a quantized variant of the model on a cheaper GPU in the same region. Both require comms.

engops-bot: NOTICE: new capacity request queued (pool_req_9f2b). Auto-retry scheduled in 15m. Current provider quotas: a100-80gb: 0 available in asia-southeast1.

maria-sales: Customer says no cross-region routing, they want everything in their APAC cloud region for compliance. We need to either get quota or offer a policy fallback accepted by their security team. Can Platform try quota request with the cloud provider now?

sara-eng: I'll open a quota raise with the cloud account now. @tom-oncall can you check if we have spare reserved GPUs in our Dedicated pool in apac that we can reassign temporarily?

tom-oncall: jumping in — looking. If we have spare capacity it's in a different reservation namespace; reassigning will require a brief rebind (minutes). I can do a manual rebind if legal approves reallocation.

ranjit-ml: Also FYI the model team's eval shows quantized LLM on a40 loses ~2% on rouge but reduces memory and could run on a40 in-region. Might be acceptable for a demo. I can produce an eval note to share with Kepler.

maria-sales: Good — please produce that short eval and I'll send to their security and infra contacts. Meanwhile, what's the repro we should give support if quota raise fails?

devon-ps: Provide these bits: project id, pool_req id, cloud provider error blob (paste below), requested SKU + AZ + size. Example payload we sent: 
```
{
  "project":"kepler-prod",
  "region":"asia-southeast1",
  "sku":"a100-80gb",
  "az_affinity":true,
  "instances":4
}
```

sara-eng: Adding to that — include the orchestration log lines from the agent: 
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z orchestrator: provisioning:start pool_req_9f2b
2026-03-20T14:02:45Z cloudapi: iam:ok
2026-03-20T14:03:03Z cloudapi:error quota_exceeded a100-80gb
2026-03-20T14:03:03Z orchestrator: provisioning:halt pool_req_9f2b reason=quota_exceeded
```

maria-sales: Perfect. Ranjit, devon, can one of you draft the short note to Kepler offering (a) temporary quantized fallback on a40 in-region, (b) single-AZ if we can secure quota, or (c) delayed start if they want strict AZ/A100 only? I'll list the timelines and pricing delta.

ranjit-ml: I'll draft the perf blurb and numbers.

devon-ps: I'll draft the operational options and include ETA for quota raise (est 2-6 hours) and manual rebind time (est 10-20 minutes) if tom confirms capacity.

maria-sales: Also Kepler asked about committed pricing for Dedicated POC — do we have a short template for a 30-day reserved commit?

sara-eng: Yes, use the POC reserved template: 30d commit with pro-rata billing, and we can include a credit if we have to migrate region or swap SKUs for the demo. I can paste the clause after this thread.

tom-oncall: quick update — I can reassign 2x a100 from an internal reserve but it will impact another low-priority demo. I need explicit approval from product ops to reallocate. If approved, I can bind to pool_req_9f2b in ~12 minutes.

maria-sales: I'm pinging product-ops and legal now. Also attaching Kepler security contact for the fallback note: security@kepler-tech.com.

engops-bot: ACTION: quota_raise_request submitted to cloud provider (ticket CP-98321). Expected response: 1-8 hours.

devon-ps: If quota request is denied, fallback plan is quantized a40 in-region with temporary SLA note. We'll need Kepler signoff on performance delta and updated appendix on security questionnaire about GPU type.

maria-sales: OK team — timeline: quota raise in progress, tom to confirm rebind if product-ops OK, ranjit to send perf summary, devon to prepare ops note, and I'll consolidate and send to Kepler in next 45m. Please react when done. :thumbsup:

sara-eng: I'm pasting the POC reserved pricing clause here for the sales email: 
```
- 30-day reserved commit
- Billing: pro-rata monthly charge based on committed vGPU instances
- SKU substitution: allowed once with written consent; substitution may alter hourly rate
- Early termination: prorated refund minus setup fee
```

maria-sales: Thanks — sending update to Kepler now. If quota bump arrives or tom confirms rebind I'll post another update.

tom-oncall: product-ops approved rebind. Reassigning resources now, will update once bound.

engops-bot: NOTE: manual_rebind completed for pool_req_9f2b -> bound to infra-reserve-17 at 2026-03-20T14:24:05Z

maria-sales: Awesome — Kepler notified and accepted temporary rebind for demo. Closing here but keeping thread for postmortem and runbook updates. :tada:
